locations.finding: The castle and Charles Bridge are far stronger Prague identifiers than an isolated minor palace. Current other three already cover bridge, clock and panorama; use castle-at-night variation if real pixels merit.

rules: Retain all existing positive-quality subjects; don't replace for count alone

No app.js/location-module/service-worker changes, no purchased IDs, XP or points changed
